say:2:1910820001:1.text: What's wrong, sister? You haven't touched anything in days. Have a sip of this whale milk stew. I added sea salt and powdered pearl.
say:2:1910820001:1.source_cn: 妹妹，你怎么了？你这几天什么都没碰，喝一口鲸奶炖汤吧，...

say:3:1910820002:1.text: Dust has settled at the bottom of your cup... Not even a home-cooked meal can open your heart anymore.
say:3:1910820002:1.source_cn: 你的杯底已经落入灰尘，难道连一顿家庭晚餐都不能打开你的...

say:4:1910820003:1.text: Oceana, there's a story circulating along the coast...
say:4:1910820003:1.source_cn: 奥汐娜，你可曾听过海岸边流传的一个故事？

say:5:1910820004:1.text: You are talking about a mortal story? You still have a soft spot for them, don't you?
say:5:1910820004:1.source_cn: 凡人的故事？你还是像以前一样对他们情有独钟。

say:6:1910820005:1.text: Come, sit down. If you finish your dinner, I'll listen to this story of yours.
say:6:1910820005:1.source_cn: 来，坐下吧，如果你愿意用完你的晚餐，那我也愿意听你说。

say:7:1910820006:1.text: ... There was a flock of white birds that nested on the highest cliff.
say:7:1910820006:1.source_cn: ……有一群白鸟，栖息在最高的悬崖上。

say:8:1910820007:1.text: They would stretch their wings again and again, darting through wind and rain. They believed that if only their wings were strong enough, they could weather any storm.
say:8:1910820007:1.source_cn: 他们不断伸展双翅，在狂风暴雨中穿梭。他们相信只要自己的...

say:9:1910820008:1.text: 直到风暴来临的那天，最强壮的白鸟伸开翼展，从悬崖上一跃而下。
say:9:1910820008:1.source_cn: 直到风暴来临的那天，最强壮的白鸟伸开翼展，从悬崖上一跃而下。

say:10:1910820009:1.text: Beneath the dark sky, the gales poured down their beaks, and the rain cascaded down their feathers.
say:10:1910820009:1.source_cn: 在紫黑色的天幕下，狂风从他们的嘴中吐出，暴雨沿着他们的...

say:11:1910820010:1.text: The storm had come, not from far away, but from within their own bodies. Their feather quills jetted wind, and rain welled up from their black-crystal eyes.
say:11:1910820010:1.source_cn: 风暴来了，并非来自远方，而是从他们自己的身体里长出来的...

say:12:1910820011:1.text: They tore out their own feathers and pecked out one another's eyes. They devoured each other in the gale. Thousands of years have passed. The cliff still stands, and the storm has never stopped.
say:12:1910820011:1.source_cn: 他们撕碎了自己的羽毛，啄瞎对方的眼睛，在狂风中互相吞噬...

say:13:1910820012:1.text: Oh, the poor birds. They destroyed themselves.
say:13:1910820012:1.source_cn: 噢，可怜的鸟儿，他们毁了自己。

say:14:1910820013:1.text: I understand the story. You're saying that the original sin of the gods will, in the end, devour the gods themselves.
say:14:1910820013:1.source_cn: 我明白这个故事，你在说神明的原罪，终将吞噬神明自己。

say:15:1910820014:1.text: Our fall from grace cannot be avoided, Oceana. That's why I've come.
say:15:1910820014:1.source_cn: 无可避免的神堕，奥汐娜。我正是为此而来。

say:16:1910820015:1.text: Dear sister, I know what you've done. Azora and Sarethiel fell, one after the other. Uncle Helthor's temper has changed entirely, and our cousin Misarte has shut herself away.
say:16:1910820015:1.source_cn: 亲爱的妹妹，我知道你曾做过的事。奥法迦和赛图恩先后陨落...

say:17:1910820016:1.text: I don't understand why you would turn your blade against your own kind and instead grow close to these mortals who have only just sprouted. However, that does not change what you are.
say:17:1910820016:1.source_cn: 我不懂你为什么会对同族兵刃相向，反而更去亲近那些刚刚抽...

say:18:1910820017:1.text: You were born different from the rest of us. I'll never fathom what goes on in your head. But as long as you are my sister, my kin, you are my family.
say:18:1910820017:1.source_cn: 你生来就与我们不同，我永远猜不透你在想什么，可只要你是...

say:19:1910820018:1.text: That's why I won't give you the chance to hurt me. I'll find a way to avoid the fall from grace. Then, you won't have a reason to make war on your kind for the sake of your mortals.
say:19:1910820018:1.source_cn: 所以我不会给你伤害我的机会——我会找到避免神堕的方法。...

say:20:1910820019:1.text: If such a path truly exists, will you sit down and share a meal with me?
say:20:1910820019:1.source_cn: 如果那种方法的确存在，你会愿意坐下与我共度晚餐吗？

say:21:1910820020:1.text: With these very eyes, I've watched the world for thousands of years. No god has ever escaped the fate that comes.
say:21:1910820020:1.source_cn: 我已用这双眼睛凝视了上万年，没有神明逃脱必将来临的命运。

say:22:1910820021:1.text: Perhaps they just aren't willing to change after all these years. Say no more of such heavy things. It pains me to see sorrow darken your face.
say:22:1910820021:1.source_cn: 那可能只是他们不愿意改变自己。不要再说那些沉重的事情了...

say:23:1910820022:1.text: You know the fate of the gods, which means you should spend more time with your own sister instead of spending your days with those mortals who vanish in the blink of an eye.
say:23:1910820022:1.source_cn: 你呀，既然知道神明的命运，就该多花些时间和自己的亲姐姐...

say:24:1910820023:1.text: I remember the last god who fell in love with a mortal. The end was wretched. What was the name of that dark-haired mortal who always followed you? Do you still remember his name?
say:24:1910820023:1.source_cn: 我记得上一个与凡人坠入爱河的神，下场可是十分凄惨呢。那...

say:25:1910820024:1.text: "Love"? Sister, my feelings for mortals are not what you think.
say:25:1910820024:1.source_cn: “爱”吗？姐姐，我对凡人的感情并非你想的那样。

say:26:1910820025:1.text: Mortals are innocent lives that are swept into the maelstrom of war among the gods. Someone must clear a path for them. That is my purpose, sister.
say:26:1910820025:1.source_cn: 凡人是无辜的生命，只是被神明的争斗卷入了漩涡，需要有人...

say:27:1910820026:1.text: Oh, you finally decided to call me sister.
say:27:1910820026:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你终于肯叫我姐姐了。

say:28:1910820027:1.text: Then, listen to your sister for once. Have you ever wondered why you alone should feel such "purpose"?
say:28:1910820027:1.source_cn: 那么，听听姐姐的话吧。你有没有想过，为什么只有你会生发...

say:29:1910820028:1.text: Dura, you are the youngest of all the gods. That's why I worry for you.
say:29:1910820028:1.source_cn: 艾雅——众神之中最年幼的那个，我很担心你。

narration:31:1910820029:1.text: The two afterimages melt like moonlight.
narration:31:1910820029:1.male: The two afterimages melt like moonlight.
narration:31:1910820029:1.female: The two afterimages melt like moonlight.

narration:32:1910820030:1.text: They fade slowly into the deep blue sea.
narration:32:1910820030:1.male: They fade slowly into the deep blue sea.
narration:32:1910820030:1.female: They fade slowly into the deep blue sea.

say:34:1910820031:2.text: What were those two going on about? Where are Elphira and the tentacle guy?!
say:34:1910820031:2.source_cn: 这俩人说什么呢，艾菲拉和触手男在哪里？！
say:34:1910820031:2.male: What were those two going on about? Where are Elphira and the tentacle guy?!
say:34:1910820031:2.female: What were those two going on about? Where are Elphira and the tentacle guy?!

say:35:1910820032:1.text: Elphira got swallowed by this monster right in front of us! They've gotta be here! We're inside that thing's body, aren't we?!
say:35:1910820032:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉在咱们眼前被怪物吞没了，他们肯定就在这里！咱们正...
say:35:1910820032:1.male: Elphira got swallowed by this monster right in front of us! They've gotta be here! We're inside that thing's body, aren't we?!

say:36:1910820033:1.male: These are images of the past, or lingering memories. You once saw past events replay in the Primal Shrine as well.

say:37:1910820034:1.text: 记忆被珍存，因为它们对记忆的主人弥足珍贵。然而，你回望四周，四周已经不再是现实中神殿雕梁画栋的景象，而是某种虚幻的空间……
say:37:1910820034:1.source_cn: 记忆被珍存，因为它们对记忆的主人弥足珍贵。然而，你回望...

say:38:1910820035:1.text: Silence. Stillness. No more rushing of Deepsea currents. No sense of time passing...
say:38:1910820035:1.source_cn: 静谧，平静，不再有深海水流的汩汩涛声，也感受不到时间的...

choice_prompt:39:1910820035.female: Silence. Stillness. No more rushing of Deepsea currents. No sense of time passing...

say:40:1910820036:1.text: I don't care if it's a memory or just the abyss! We're the only ones who can help Coralia. Everyone else...
say:40:1910820036:1.source_cn: 不管是记忆还是深渊，塔拉萨只能靠咱们了，其他人都……
say:40:1910820036:1.male: I don't care if it's a memory or just the abyss! We're the only ones who can help Coralia. Everyone else...
say:40:1910820036:1.female: I don't care if it's a memory or just the abyss! We're the only ones who can help Coralia. Everyone else...

say:41:1910820037:1.text: How the heck can we bring the others back?! There's no one here!
say:41:1910820037:1.source_cn: 该死，要怎么把其他人带回来？！这里空无一人！
say:41:1910820037:1.male: How the heck can we bring the others back?! There's no one here!
say:41:1910820037:1.female: How the heck can we bring the others back?! There's no one here!

say:42:1910820038:1.text: 洋流神正在复苏，神明的意识在取代个体的意识……记忆，个体，群体，凡人与神。
say:42:1910820038:1.source_cn: 洋流神正在复苏，神明的意识在取代个体的意识……记忆，个...

say:43:1910820039:1.text: As you recall the names of Elphira and Calix, a familiar figure flickers into view. Mortals cannot contend with divine power. Yes, you were taught that ten thousand years ago. Only a god can stand against a god.
say:43:1910820039:1.source_cn: 你想起呼唤艾菲拉与卡律的名字时，有熟悉的身影闪动。凡人...

say:44:1910820040:1.text: But the friends you've made on this journey are fragments of the divine. What you've come to know is not some alien god, but living, breathing individuals. These people took you for their own.
say:44:1910820040:1.source_cn: 但你这一路所结识的朋友们，是神的碎片。你所熟知的并非陌...
